videos.title: 7 UI/UX mistakes that SCREAM you’re a beginner
videos.why: Common slips such as overused effects, uneven spacing, inconsistent components, awkward icons and missing feedback, each with a fix that does not need a redesign.

videos.title: Steve Schoger | Refactoring UI | CSS Day 2019
videos.why: A designer takes a weak interface and polishes it live, naming each small change as he goes, so you learn to see what makes a screen look finished.

podcasts.episode: 74: Steve Schoger - Tactical Design Advice for Developers
podcasts.why: Practical advice for developers on fonts, colour, designing in greyscale first and making things look professional without graphic design training.

podcasts.episode: Josh Puckett - Crafting interfaces with uncommon care
podcasts.why: A designer with two decades of product work on what taking uncommon care over an interface looks like in practice.

reads.title: Web Interface Guidelines
reads.why: A long, specific checklist of interaction, layout, content and performance details, ideal to run against a site before launch or to paste into an AI tool.

reads.title: Web Vitals
reads.why: The three measures Google uses for how fast and stable a page feels, so you can check that polish does not cost speed.

reads.title: Refactoring UI
reads.why: A paid book of specific design tactics explained from a developer's point of view, by the team behind Tailwind CSS; two sample chapters are free.
